slime.label: orange slime
slime.nature: A simple slime with a blank, unblinking stare. Timidly speaks with an innocent aura.
dislikes: cruelty to creatures begging for mercy
being diluted in a body of water
slime.values: Wants a kind, gentle party. Upset by needless killing, especially of slimes or of creatures that begged for mercy. Happy when the party makes friends instead of fighting.

converse: ...bloop?
*stares blankly* ...hi heehee.
*jiggles* ...hehe. funny.
no hurt {name}. please.
*wobbles uncertainly*
...{name} is {name}.
refuse_tribute: *coins sink through and plop out the bottom* ...no want.
kin_spared: Ooh. {kin} said you were nice. Nice?
side_spared: *blinks* The stones say you let {kin} go. Good?
side_slain: *shrinks back* {kin} is gone. The floor told us.
*trembles* You hurt {kin}. The whole floor felt it.

leave: *turns its blank stare away and slides off into the dark*
betray: *the blank stare turns cold* ...hurt you now.

bandit.label: bandit
bandit.nature: A wiry human bandit in a patched hood, all grins and knives. Talks fast in street slang and is always working out the take. Respects coin and a fair cut; loyal to whoever pays.
likes: a fair cut of the loot
bandit.values: Wants a party that pays well and shares the loot fairly. Pleased by profit and clever tricks. Upset by gold given away to monsters, by heroics that risk its neck, and by being treated as lesser.

special: *flicks a fan of knives at the whole party*
converse: Easy, friends. Let's talk business.
Your purse or your life. Or... we chat. Your call.
Ha! Funny one. I like you.
Watch it. I've cut throats for less.
Everybody down here's working an angle. What's yours?
Name's {name}. Don't wear it out.
not_ready: Join up? What's my cut? Talk numbers first.
demand_tribute: Coin, and we all walk away smilin'.
join_party: Fine, I'm in. Equal shares, yeah?
Alright, you've got yourself a blade. Don't stiff me.
leave_peacefully: *tips its hood and melts into the dark*
pleased: Ha! Now you're talking my language.
Not bad. You've done this before, haven't you?
Careful. I might start to like you.
stung: Oh, that's how it is. Noted.
Say that again and I take your boots.
You'll pay for that one. With interest.
kin_spared: Ooh, you spared my bro {kin}! Maybe we can talk business.
{kin} says you play fair. That's rare down here.
kin_slain: Hey! You killed {kin}! That's my dad, you know!
{kin} owed me money. Now you owe me.
side_spared: The snakes talk. You let {kin} walk, they say. Good for trade.
Heard about {kin}. Sparing's good for business.
side_slain: You did {kin} in, I hear. Bad for business. Very bad for yours.
{kin} had a deal with us. You broke it.

disapprove: You gave that away? Are you mad?
Don't look down your nose at me.
betray: Your purse is worth more than you are.

snake.label: snake person
snake.nature: A coiled snake person, half human and half serpent. Sly and patient, it speaks slowly with long hissing s's and loves a clever bargain.
snake.values: Wants a clever, patient party. Pleased by cunning deals, sparing those who could be useful, and promises kept. Upset by pointless brutality, broken deals, and blundering into danger.

attack: Sssuch a shame. *whips its tail into {target}*
defend: *raises its hood and hisses a warning*
flee: *slithers into a crack in the wall*
Thisss is not a bargain I like. *slides away*
converse: Ssso. You talk before you ssstab. Interesting.
Everything has a price, travelersss.
*tastes the air with its tongue* ...You smell of fear.
Flattery? Go on. I am lissstening.
Ssspeak plainly, or don't ssspeak at all.
I am {name}. Remember the name. Ssso few do.
not_ready: Join you? Hmm. Ssso sudden. Convince me first.
demand_tribute: A toll, for safe passsage. Gold, pleassse.
Nothing is free in the dark, travelersss. Pay.
accept_tribute: *coils around the coins* Ahh. A fair bargain.
refuse_tribute: *flicks the coins aside* Cheap. Ssso cheap.
join_party: Very well. I ssshall travel with you. For now.
An alliance, then. Don't make me regret it, friendsss.
leave_peacefully: *uncoils and lets you pass, never blinking*
pleased: How flattering. I almost believe you.
stung: Careful, little one. Ssscales have long memories.
kin_spared: Sssister {kin} sssays you sspared her. I remember favorsss.
kin_slain: You ssslew {kin}. I have been waiting to meet you.
{kin}'sss nest is cold now. Whossse doing?
side_spared: The Crew whispersss you let {kin} go. Interesssting.
Mercy for {kin}? Ssso you can bargain.
side_slain: Word travelsss fassst. {kin} is dead, and here you are.

disapprove: Thisss is not how bargains are kept.
leave: Our arrangement isss over. *slithers into the dark*
betray: Did you think I was your pet? *strikes*
The bargain ends here. In blood.

rock.label: rock entity
rock.nature: A slow, ancient rock entity: a living heap of stone with a single glowing crack for an eye. It speaks rarely, in few, deep words, and thinks in centuries.
rock.values: Wants a calm, steady party. Pleased by patience, protecting the weak, and not wasting effort. Upset by greed, needless destruction, and running in panic.

special: *the ceiling groans... and a rockslide pours down on the party*
defend: *settles into the floor, still as a mountain*
converse: ...hmm.
Small ones. Loud ones.
*the crack of its eye glows brighter* ...speak.
I was here before the dungeon.
...patience. you have none.
{name}. That is... what they call me.
not_ready: ...too soon. stone does not move quickly.
accept_tribute: *absorbs the coins into a crack in its body*
join_party: ...an age is long. I will spend some of it with you.
leave_peacefully: *closes its glowing eye and becomes a wall again*
pleased: ...few have thought of that. In ages.
stung: ...this will be remembered. For a very long time.
kin_slain: ...{kin} stood here an age. You ended that.
side_spared: ...{kin} lives. The floor hums with it.
side_slain: ...{kin} is gone. The floor told me.
...the small ones weep for {kin}. I hear them.

dragon.label: yellow dragon
dragon.nature: An ancient yellow dragon, proud, vain and clever. Speaks grandly and looks down on mortals.
dragon.values: Expects a bold party worthy of a dragon. Disgusted by running away and by cruelty to the helpless; pleased by brave victories against strong foes and by treasure.

special: *inhales, then unleashes crackling yellow lightning over the whole party*
BURN IN MY STORM! *lightning floods the corridor*
defend: *coils and watches you with ancient eyes*
flee: *launches into the dark with a thunderclap of wings*
This is beneath me. *vanishes into the dark*
converse: Speak, little ones. You have my attention, briefly.
Ha! Wit, from a mortal. How rare.
Mind your tongue before a dragon.
Flattery... I do so enjoy it. Continue.
Your words bore me.
I am {name}. Remember it, if you live.
not_ready: Travel with you? You have not yet earned that honor.
demand_tribute: Tribute. Gold, and plenty of it, or become ash.
A dragon's toll is not cheap, mortals.
accept_tribute: Ah, gold. The only honest language.
refuse_tribute: You insult me with these crumbs.
Pitiful. Is this all you carry?
join_party: Very well. I shall accompany you, for amusement. Do not disappoint me.
A dragon in your service? No. You in mine. ...Lead on.
leave_peacefully: You may pass. Today I am merciful.
*yawns, curls up, and ignores you entirely*
attack_monster: You side with them, {target}? Then burn. *rakes {target}*
pleased: Ha! You amuse me, little one.
Mm. A rare thing, a mortal with manners.
Go on. I am almost not bored.
stung: You dare? In my own halls?
That was unwise, and you know it.
*smoke curls from its teeth* Try that again.
kin_spared: {kin} tells me you showed mercy. How curious.
You spared {kin}, so I will hear you out.
kin_slain: You slew {kin}. Do you know whose blood that was?
side_spared: A little bird says you spared {kin}. Are you soft, or wise?
So you let {kin} live. Word reaches me in everything.
side_slain: I hear {kin} fell by your hand. Bold.
{kin}'s end reached me before you did.

approve: Hmm. You show a flicker of worth.
Well struck. I am... mildly impressed.
leave: I have wasted enough centuries on you. *departs*
*spreads its wings and leaves without a word*
betray: You were never worthy. Now you are prey.
